title: RCP Registry — IngredientClass
description: A governed ingredient-class entry (DECISIONS #16/#23; registry-governance guideline). Recipes reference the class id; the shopping layer resolves class to product. Entries are append-only: never deleted or repurposed — deprecate and add.

id.description: Kind-prefixed stable slug (DECISIONS #23). Never encodes display names; never changes once merged. Flour types always explicit (T65, T80…).

display_name.description: Localized display names; pt-PT culinary terms exact (massa velha ≠ isco). The id is never localized.

roles.description: Functional roles this class typically supplies (machine-read: substitution, safety, basis). Membership in the core role enum is enforced by the L2 linter against schema/rcp-core-v1.schema.json#/$defs/role — single source, not duplicated here.

density.description: Weight↔volume conversion lives per class in the catalog, never in recipes (research 00:679-684).

allergens.description: EU FIC 14 — a legal list, so a closed enum is correct (research 02:367-374).

status.description: Append-only lifecycle: deprecated entries stay resolvable forever.
